Intro: My friend… Why the long face?

…Ah, about the advertisement… Unfortunately, your food just was not up to standard. I'm sure you understand how business goes. Some things are better left unspoken, unless you would have preferred a scathing review?
Now, I would love to have some [DISH] to fill me up.
Success: Maybe I was mistaken; it was surely a fluke last time, was it not? Don't worry your little head about it, friend. I'm sure our friend is reasonable enough to listen.
Fail: Hm… was I mistaken about you? Actually, let me hold my tongue; Mother told me if I don't have anything nice to say, I shouldn't speak. I'll take my leave, comrade.
Reject: Tch, what is with this sudden change of heart? I thought we were comrades, friend. It's alright. I'm sure my dear friend will have something to say.
